mechanism_gate.criterion: At least2/3 frozen seeds and the across-seed mean have positive deterministic-minus-stochastic native cost on24 paired resets. No seed excluded.

extra_probe_budget: Both arms: up to336k extra simulation steps, separately from2M training steps and312 final episodes.

paired_final_recount.limits: Fixed12-policy exploratory CG2 matrix; partial paired rows are descriptive only. Aggregate comparisons require all3training seeds at a fixed hard tolerance. No checkpoint selection, automatic promotion, SOTA or zero-risk conclusion.
